definition.title: Find campus events to reach student buyers
definition.description: For a business whose buyers are students: finds upcoming campus events near them, or compares ones you paste, ranks them and drafts one small activation to pitch. Research only; never contacts organizers, pays for a sponsorship or collects student data.

event_briefs.title: Events to compare (optional)
event_briefs.description: Public event descriptions with their source URLs, when the founder already has candidates. Leave empty and the run searches for upcoming campus events itself.

audience.title: Which students, and where (optional)
audience.description: Overrides the onboarding plan, for example: computer science students at universities in Pune. Fill it when the plan does not name a campus, city or region.

business.title: Product and offer (optional)
business.description: Overrides the onboarding plan and the Feature map. Leave empty when either exists.

budget.title: Budget or practical limits (optional)
budget.description: Overrides the budget and founder hours in the onboarding plan, for example: up to INR 5000 and one person for two hours.

prerequisites.reason: The growth plan says what the business sells, who its students are, the budget and founder hours, and hard no's the activation must respect.
The Feature map supplies the real product detail the activation demonstrates.
A captured writing style guide shapes the drafted sign and on-site line.
